text: Add agent memory to an app with just three lines of code
quote: Add agent memory to your app in three lines of code.

text: Context retrieval completes in under 200ms regardless of graph size or number of graphs
quote: Zep delivers sub-200ms context retrieval regardless of graph size or number of graphs.

text: Ingest chat messages, JSON, text, documents, and business data into a Context Graph
quote: Zep builds a Context Graph from chat messages, business data, documents, and JSON.

text: Customize entity and relation types in the Context Graph using Pydantic-like classes
quote: Feature allowing use of Pydantic-like classes to customize creation/retrieval of entities and relations in the Context Graph.

text: Provides a guide for migrating existing Mem0 users to Zep
quote: Migrating from Mem0? Check out our [Mem0 Migration](/mem0-to-zep) guide.

text: Deleting a user erases all their threads and thread data in one API call for RTBF/privacy compliance
quote: Deleting a User will delete all Threads and thread artifacts associated with that User with a single API call, making it easy to handle Right To Be Forgotten requests.

text: Memory MCP Server lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex and other MCP clients access a user's own agent memory
quote: The Memory MCP Server lets an end user connect an MCP client (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others) to their own agent memory in Zep.

text: zepctl CLI gives full administrative access to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data from the terminal
quote: zepctl is a command-line interface for administering Zep projects. It provides full access to Zep, enabling you to manage users, threads, Context Graphs, and data operations from the terminal.

text: Thread summaries are automatically generated and incrementally updated as conversations progress
quote: A thread summary is a natural-language summary of the messages in a single thread, generated and incrementally updated by Zep.

text: Graph search combines semantic similarity search with BM25 full-text keyword search
quote: Zep graph search combines semantic similarity with BM25 full-text search.

text: scope='auto' dynamically composes relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, observations and summaries into one block
quote: set scope="auto" and let Zep dynamically compose the most relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, observations, and thread summaries into a single ready-to-use block.

text: Context Block can be returned directly from the thread.add_messages() call, avoiding a separate retrieval request
quote: You can request the Context Block directly in the response to the `thread.add_messages()` call. This optimization eliminates the need for a separate `thread.get_user_context()` call.

text: Role-based access control governs dashboard users while attribute-based access control governs API keys and UserGroups
quote: Role-based access control governs dashboard users. Attribute-based access control governs API keys and UserGroups.

text: Deleting a graph node also deletes all edges connected to that node
quote: Deleting a node will also delete all edges connected to that node.

text: Zep integrates with supported agent frameworks, persisting conversation turns and retrieving from the user's Context Graph
quote: Zep provides agent memory for agents that you build with supported frameworks. The integrations persist conversation turns and retrieve data from the user's Context Graph.

text: Graphiti is an open-source temporal knowledge graph framework for building and querying a Context Graph locally
quote: Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework. Use it to build and query a single Context Graph per subject locally

text: Graphiti's Context Graph uses a bi-temporal model with fact invalidation for temporal reasoning
quote: Graphiti is the open-source temporal knowledge graph framework. Use it to build and query a single Context Graph per subject locally — entity and edge extraction, the bi-temporal model, fact invalidation, and hybrid retrieval.

text: Graphiti's Context Graphs can be connected to Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients via a dedicated Graphiti MCP server
quote: Connect Graphiti's Context Graphs to Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients via the Graphiti MCP server.

text: Zep can be deployed via Zep Cloud or within your own VPC
quote:
Deploy anywhere

CloudYour VPC

text: Adding chat messages via thread.add_messages both records thread history and ingests them into the user-level knowledge graph
quote: Chat messages are added to threads using `thread.add_messages`, which both adds those messages to the thread history and ingests those messages into the user-level knowledge graph.

text: Individual edges can be deleted from the graph via a direct API call
quote: Here's how to delete an edge from a graph: client.graph.edge.delete(uuid_="your_edge_uuid")

text: Policies enforce least-privilege access to context for agents and Memory MCP users
quote: Use policies when you need least-privilege access to context for agents and Memory MCP users.

text: AI assistants like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code with Copilot can access Graphiti's Context Graph for persistent contextual awareness
quote: This enables AI assistants like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code with Copilot to interact with Graphiti's Context Graph capabilities, providing persistent context and contextual awareness.

text: Zep offers documented integrations with LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, AutoGen, LiveKit, Strands, Vercel AI SDK, and Eve
quote: Use Zep as agent memory with LangGraph, CrewAI, Google ADK, AutoGen, LiveKit, Strands, Vercel AI SDK, Eve, and other supported frameworks.

text: ABAC policies attached to API keys and UserGroups limit which actions and context each agent or MCP user can reach
quote: Limit which actions and context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach with ABAC policies attached to API keys and UserGroups.

text: Graphiti tracks how facts change over time and maintains provenance to source data, supporting prescribed and learned ontologies
quote: Graphiti's context graphs track how facts change over time, maintain provenance to source data, and support both prescribed and learned ontology

text: Whenever an application user is created, a corresponding Zep user must be created to track their memory
quote: Whenever users are created in your application, you need to trigger the creation of a Zep user.
